Build passes now (exit 0). The rest of the log is genuinely just noise (Node deprecation warnings and lint-style notices from the bump), but two spots were real bugs from the bundler's option-shape change:

- `src/core/options.js:7` — was reading `options.retries`, but the new bundler passes `retryCount`; threw `TypeError` on `undefined.toFixed()`.
- `src/net/retryPolicy.js:8` — new config loader leaves unset flags as `undefined` instead of `false`, and the strict boolean check threw on anything that wasn't exactly `true`/`false`. Simplified to `=== true`, which correctly treats `undefined` as disabled.

Both are now fixed and the build completes cleanly (`0 errors`, only the expected deprecation warnings remain).
